text_ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ
transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah
text_en_translation: We have reached the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah. Praise be to Allah. There is no deity but Allah, alone, without partner.

text_ar: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ
transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah
text_en_translation: We have reached the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah. Praise be to Allah. There is no deity but Allah, alone, without partner.

text_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi alladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin nushur
text_en_translation: Praise be to Allah who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the return.

text_ar: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya
text_en_translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma iftah li abwaba rahmatik
text_en_translation: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy.

text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik
text_en_translation: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.

text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
transliteration: Bismillah
text_en_translation: In the name of Allah.

text_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi alladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
text_en_translation: Praise be to Allah who has fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power from myself.

text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Allahi rabbina tawakkalna
text_en_translation: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we rely.

text_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
transliteration: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'ala Allah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
text_en_translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power or strength except with Allah.

text_ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
transliteration: Ashhadu an la ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh
text_en_translation: I bear witness that there is no deity but Allah alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.

text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u bidhanbi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfirudhdhunuba illa ant
text_en_translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I am keeping my covenant and promise to You as much as I can. I seek refuge with You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none can forgive sins except You.

text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal khubthi wal khaba'ith
text_en_translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female evil spirits.

text_ar: غُفْرَانَكَ
transliteration: Ghufranak
text_en_translation: I seek Your forgiveness.

text_ar: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
transliteration: Subhana alladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun
text_en_translation: Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it by our own efforts. And to our Lord we shall surely return.

text_ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
transliteration: La ilaha illa Allahul 'azim al-halim, la ilaha illa Allahu rabbul 'arshil 'azim, la ilaha illa Allahu rabbus samawati wa rabbul ardi wa rabbul 'arshil karim
text_en_translation: There is no deity but Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing. There is no deity but Allah, Lord of the Great Throne. There is no deity but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
transliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'a
text_en_translation: O Allah, make it a beneficial downpour.

text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha wa a'udhu bika min sharriha
text_en_translation: O Allah, I ask You of its good and seek refuge in You from its evil.

text_ar: لاَ بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
transliteration: La ba'sa tahurun in sha'Allah
text_en_translation: No worry, may it be a purification, if Allah wills.

text_ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لاَ يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: La ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamd, yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa hayyun la yamut, biyadihil khayr, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
text_en_translation: There is no deity but Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is Ever Living and never dies. In His hand is all good, and He is over all things competent.

text_ar: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
transliteration: Rabbi zidni 'ilma
text_en_translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

text_ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
transliteration: Rabbana atina fid dunya hasanatan wa fil akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban nar
text_en_translation: Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

occasion: Seeking protection from anxiety and debt
text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal hammi wal hazan, wa a'udhu bika minal 'ajzi wal kasal, wa a'udhu bika minal jubni wal bukhl, wa a'udhu bika min ghalabatid dayni wa qahrir rijal
text_en_translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief, from weakness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from the burden of debt and being overpowered by men.

occasion: For good in this life and the next
text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِيَ الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي
transliteration: Allahumma aslih li deeniya alladhi huwa 'ismatu amri, wa aslih li dunyaya allati feeha ma'ashi, wa aslih li akhirati allati feeha ma'adi
text_en_translation: O Allah, rectify for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs, rectify for me my worldly life in which is my livelihood, and rectify for me my Hereafter to which I shall return.

text_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
transliteration: Subhan Allah, Alhamdu lillah, Allahu Akbar
text_en_translation: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, Allah is the Greatest. (Repeat 33 times each after prayer)

text_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي
transliteration: Allahumma ihdini wa saddidni
text_en_translation: O Allah, guide me and keep me firm.

text_ar: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
transliteration: Rabbi irhamhuma kama rabbayani saghira
text_en_translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.

text_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: Subhan Allahi wa bihamdih, Subhan Allahil 'Adheem
text_en_translation: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him. Glory be to Allah, the Magnificent.

text_ar: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ
transliteration: U'idhukuma bikalimatillah at-tammah, min kulli shaytanin wa hammah, wa min kulli 'aynin lammah
text_en_translation: I seek refuge for you both in the perfect words of Allah, from every devil and harmful creature, and from every evil eye.

text_ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
transliteration: La ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
text_en_translation: There is no deity but Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise. He is over all things competent. (Say 100 times daily)
